chars.DJ: a Moroccan man around 30, black hair with a short fade, trimmed black beard, wearing a black bomber jacket with a single white stripe on each sleeve, plain black t-shirt, thin silver chain, a small white plaster on his left cheekbone
chars.SWEDE: a young Swedish woman in her twenties, long straight platinum-blonde hair, light freckles, wearing a mint-green oversized hoodie and white wide-leg jeans, small tan backpack

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from a café doorway in Casablanca (witness point of view), head-to-waist framing: SWEDE stands at a small café table mid-gesture, both palms raised in disbelief, frowning and asking him why he did it, face clearly visible; DJ sits in front of her, embarrassed, rubbing the back of his neck. Daytime, simple calm background.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot: DJ shakes his head and waves his hands nervously, explaining himself, awkward smile; SWEDE in the foreground from behind her shoulder, arms crossed. Casablanca café terrace, daytime.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: DJ leans across the café table, one hand on his chest, confessing his feelings with big hopeful eyes; SWEDE leans back in her chair, eyebrows raised, surprised. Warm afternoon light, Casablanca street softly blurred behind.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: SWEDE stands up from the café table, putting on her backpack, politely shaking her head no with an apologetic half smile; DJ stays seated, frozen, jaw dropped, comically heartbroken. Casablanca café, daytime.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: SWEDE walks away through a bright airport departure hall in Casablanca pulling a white suitcase, waving goodbye over her shoulder without looking back; departure board shapes blurred, no readable text.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: DJ sits alone on a Casablanca rooftop at dusk, chin in his hand, staring at his phone with a sad hopeful face, waiting for a message that never comes; laundry lines and satellite dishes calm in the background.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: DJ in a grey tank top (bomber jacket hung on a hook) pushing a heavy barbell bench press in a small neighbourhood gym in Casablanca, determined fierce face, sweat on his forehead, the small plaster still on his cheek.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: DJ in his black bomber jacket at a DJ booth setting up equipment in an empty club in the afternoon, focused calm face, headphones around his neck, tidy and professional, soft daylight from an open door.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: DJ walks away from a closed nightclub entrance at night in Casablanca toward the sunrise-lit street, hands in his jacket pockets, relieved smile; a big bouncer at the club door watches him leave, arms crossed, neon glow without any letters.
